summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of Cowa's operating subsidiaries, which own a 41.5MW data center facility in Norway for $41 million total consideration (approximately 4x EBITDA). The deal, originally announced December 30, 2025, closed after regulatory approvals. The facility is powered by 100% renewable hydroelectric energy at <$0.035/kWh, with an additional 40MW expansion potential subject to approval. Annualized revenues are ~$31 million with $10 million EBITDA contribution. The company is now discussing AI compute tenant opportunities. This is a non-US issuer, mapped to an acquisition completion. Watch for integration execution and potential tenant agreements to materialize AI compute value and support the pro-forma EBITDA target.
